text: The Jonsson School Office of Undergraduate Advising is working to improve response time to emails. In the meantime, please help us by doing the following: For information about courses and prerequisites, review our degree plans and flowcharts. For all other questions, email ecs_ugadvising@utdallas.edu. Office: ECSS 2.502. Do not email multiple addresses as it slows down the process. We are prioritizing registration for engineering and computer science students. Other concerns? Email Kim Calvert-Gibson, Interim Director of Advising, Dr. Stephen Crynes, Director. of Advising, or Dr. Joshua Summers, Interim Associate Dean for Undergraduate Education. Please see below for the types of assistance we can provide by email and video chat.
